text: Guided systematic-review workflow covering search, screening, extraction, and a final report
quote: The Systematic Reviews workflow provides step-by-step guidance through search, screening, and data extraction, culminating in a research report summarizing the relevant papers.

text: Users can set an effort level (Fastest to Smartest) for each Research Agent run
quote: click it to open the slider and move between Fastest, Fast, Balanced, Smart, and Smartest

text: Instant email alerts notify users when new relevant papers are found
quote: Turn on **Instant email alerts** to be immediately alerted whenever a new relevant research paper is found.

text: Users can import their reference library from Zotero
Library can be exported as .ris for use in Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, etc.
quote: Your Elicit Library can be exported as a .ris file, which you can import into Zotero, Mendeley, EndNote, or another reference manager.

text: Product offers API access for programmatic use
Projects link multiple sessions together for continuity across related work
quote: Projects in Elicit allow you to link together multiple sessions for fluid reasoning across different aspects of your work.

text: Skills let users define reusable instructions that shape how the agent approaches a task
quote: A skill is a set of instructions you can hand to Elicit's agent so it approaches a task a particular way.

text: Team members can be invited to collaborate live within a Research Agent session
quote: Invite your team members to collaborate live with you in Research Agent sessions.

text: Collaborators with edit access can query the agent and create or edit artifacts (docs, tables)
quote: Collaborators with edit access can ask the agent questions in your session, produce new artifacts (documents, tables, etc.), and edit other artifacts

text: Browser extension uses the user's active institutional logins to fetch accessible papers
quote: The extension uses your active logins in your browser to download papers you can access via your institution.

text: Users can add extraction columns simply by telling the agent in natural language what to add
quote: To add a column, simply tell the research agent what column(s) you'd like to add. For example, you can say: "Add a column for study type."

text: Research Agent pulls from a wide range of sources, produces flexible outputs, and lets users iterate to refine results
quote: the Research Agent can pull from a wide range of sources (e.g. publications, public filings, press releases), produce flexible outputs, and let you iterate until you have exactly what you need

text: Elicit automatically fetches full-text PDFs during the data-extraction phase of a review
quote: Elicit will automatically fetch papers during the data extraction phase of your Systematic Reviews

text: Users can define custom columns to extract specific data points from paper text or tables
quote: Create a column for each data point you'd like to extract from your papers. Columns can pull data from the papers' body text or from tables in the papers.

text: Pro/Scale/Enterprise users can export systematic-review screening and extraction tables
quote: Pro, Scale, and Enterprise subscribers can export tables from Systematic Reviews, including the screening recommendation tables and the data extraction table.

text: Semantic search lets users find relevant papers using natural-language queries instead of exact keywords
quote: With Elicit's semantic search engine, you can ask a question in natural language, and Elicit will find relevant papers, without you having to think of every possible keyword to search for.

text: Within a chat session users can filter/export sources, generate figures, and draft slides without leaving the conversation
quote: you can filter and export your sources, generate figures, and draft slides, all without leaving the conversation
